topic: An NBA reporter who gets treated like part of the team when they win.

hook.first_words: This guy has the best job in the NBA,
hook.first_frame: An NBA reporter standing with players holding a towel.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: This guy has the best job in the NBA,

shots.shows: NBA reporter holding microphone surrounded by players holding a towel
Reporter being jokingly choked and neck-rubbed by players
Reporter interviewing player while other players drape towels over him
Reporter wearing a team hoodie being interviewed/gregarious with players
Reporter talking with players in uniforms
Players surprising reporter with custom t-shirt featuring his face

ending.last_frame: Reporter smiling wearing custom shirt with players laughing behind him

script: This guy has the best job in the NBA, because every time his team wins, he gets to interview them and just have fun. Like when the Thunder put a bunch of towels on him as he asked questions. Or when they gave him a full outfit like he was going to play for them. But I think the coolest thing that's happened to him is when the Thunder surprised him with his own custom shirt!
retention_tricks: visual escalation ending in the final surprise reveal
what_makes_it_work: Compelling premise about an enviable reporter job
Pace of clips matching the upbeat voiceover
Payoff ending with the custom shirt surprise
